entries.title: Genesis 33:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Jacob and Esau's meeting; and Esau's departure. 17 Jacob comes to Succoth. 18 At Shalem he buys a field, and builds an altar, called El-elohe-Israel.

Esau came. 27:41,42; 32:6 And he. 32:7,16

entries.title: Genesis 33:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: What meanest thou by all this drove? Heb. What is all thisband to thee? 32:13-20 to find. 32:5; 39:5; Es 2:17

entries.title: Genesis 33:9
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: have enough. 27:39; Pr 30:15; Ec 4:8 my brother. 4:9; 27:41; Jud 20:23; Pr 16:7; Ac 9:17; 21:20; Phm 1:7,16 keep that thou hast unto thyself. Heb. be that to thee thatis thine.

entries.title: Genesis 33:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
if now. 19:19; 47:29; 50:4; Ex 33:12,13; Ru 2:10; 1Sa 20:3; Jer 31:2 receive.To accept a present from an inferior was a customary pledge of friendship; but returning it implied disaffection. It was on this ground that Jacob was so urgent with Esau to receive his present.

I have seen. 32:30; 43:3; 2Sa 3:13; 14:24,28,32; Job 33:26; Ps 41:11; Mt 18:10 Re 22:4

entries.title: Genesis 33:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
according as, etc.Heb. according to the foot of the work, etc.; and according to the foot of the children.

be able. Isa 40:11; Mr 4:33; Ro 15:1; 1Co 3:2; 9:19-22 unto Seir. 32:3; De 2:1; Jud 5:4; 2Ch 20:10; Eze 25:8; 35:2,3

entries.title: Genesis 33:15
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
leave. Heb. set, or place.What needeth it? Heb. Wherefore is this?

find grace. 34:11; 47:25; Ru 2:13; 1Sa 25:8; 2Sa 16:4

entries.title: Genesis 33:17
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Succoth. Jos 13:27; Jud 8:5,8,16; 1Ki 7:46; Ps 60:6 not. Ex 12:37; 13:20 Succoth. i.e., Booths.Succoth was on the east of Jordan, between the brook Jabbok and that river, about 40 miles from Jerusalem, and consequently near Penuel; where a city was afterwards built, which Joshua assigned to the tribe of Gad. Jerome says, that Succoth was in the district of Scythopolis; and the Jews inform us, that the name of Darala was sometime after applied to it.

entries.title: Genesis 33:18
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
Shalem.The word {Shalem,} in the Samaritan {Shalom,} should probably be rendered "in peace," or "in safety;" as it is translated by the Chaldee, Arabic, Coverdale, and Matthewes.

Joh 3:23; 4:5; Ac 7:16 a city of Shechem.Or, rather, "the city Shechem," which was situated in a narrow valley, abounding with springs, between Mounts Ebal and Gerizim, having the former on the north, and the latter on the south; 10 miles from Shiloh, and 34 from Jerusalem. It became the capital of Samaria, after the ruin of the city of that name.

Jos 24:1; Jud 9:1; Joh 4:5 Sychar. Ac 7:16 Sychem. Padan-aram. 25:20; 28:6,7; 35:9; 46:15

entries.title: Genesis 33:19
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: bought. 23:17-20; 49:30-32; Jos 24:32; Joh 4:5; Ac 7:16 Hamor. 34:2-31; Ac 7:16 Emmor. pieces of money. or, lambs.

entries.title: Genesis 33:20
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: altar. 8:20; 12:7,8; 13:18; 21:33 El-elohe-Israel. i.e., God, the God of Israel. 32:28; 35:7
